title: Tuesday Night Meditation and Dharma Teaching                                                      Join us in community!

description:
We meet every Tuesday evening at NEST CO-WORKING SPACE,
414 Fayetteville Street - 4th floor.  For the door code send an email to info@sitraleigh.com or text me at 919-306-9495. (if you already have the code it stays the same)

For our teaching this Tuesday 12/1, we will get back into the big picture of the Buddha's core Teachings.  A few weeks back we took a look at the Four Noble Truths, with the Fourth Truth being "the path that leads to the end of suffering".  This week we will sit with the first four factors of the Noble Eightfold Path. These four include Wise Understanding or View, Wise Intention or Resolve, Wise Speech or Communication and Wise Action. These four include both Wisdom and Ethical Factors of the Three Trainings. (The third Factor is Wise Concentration or Mental Discipline). The more clarity we have regarding the inter-connectedness of Eightfold Path, the easier it will be for us to integrate and embody these teachings. They are the core set of tools in our Buddhist Tool Chest.
 
The Buddha told his cousin and attendant, Annanda, that Sangha (community) was "the Whole of the Spiritual Life". I invite you to be part of the Sit Raleigh Sangha, - Join us in person or on Zoom.

We begin with a 25-30 minute meditation and finish with the Dharma talk. All are welcome. Class by Dana (generosity) venmo link in the about us page here on the site. 

Parking is free after 6pm on the street (in legal spaces) in downtown Raleigh. We are also on ZOOM if you cannot make it in person. (To join just click the register link button and you will join the meeting)
